captainBroadcast.subject: Builders were blocked by the preflight, not by corpus permissions. Both are now resolved. Reset and continue.
whatWasActuallyWrong: FIX-B reported PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY and diagnosed it as the session token lacking read access to Roger-LegalEase/legalease-source-artifacts. That diagnosis was one step off.
The token already reads that repository. Captain verified it directly: GET /repos/Roger-LegalEase/legalease-source-artifacts/releases/tags/source-corpus-2026-08-28 answered HTTP 200.

The real failure was browser_environment_exported. The central raster split made page_rasterizer_available opt-in behind --require-rasterizer but left browser_environment_exported mandatory, so every PF, FIX, DISC, SRC, ACQ and PROMO lane failed preflight for a browser it never opens. READY was unreachable for every builder in the fleet, with or without a corpus.
doThisNow: 1. Fetch the Captain branch and reset your clean worker branch to the new shiftBaseSha in this file. The previous base could not pass preflight.
2. Recover the Master Library into your own worktree: bash scripts/rcap-corpus/bootstrap-private-corpus.sh
3. Re-run your family preflight. Expect: PACKET_BUILD_ENVIRONMENT_READY: 13/13 passed, 0 failed, 3 not applicable.
4. Resume your lane queue at the family where you stopped. Do not re-dispatch and do not wait for a token grant; neither is needed.
corpusNotes: The bootstrap downloads ~140 MB, verifies the archive against sha256 a26e3ca7d52db4460e53c2eddd893109037702f5c8035f2c698a7e16bad84e89, and refuses rather than guesses on any mismatch.
It extracts 51 jurisdictions / 499 files / 329 PDFs into private/source-imports/, which is git-ignored. It never commits a byte and never prints the token.

Do NOT export MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR. The default install root is where the preflight already looks; setting it is how a Master Library ends up mounted at the operational path, which the preconditions refuse by name.
The Master Library is NOT the operational Nationwide tree. Do not substitute one for the other.

No legal, source, contract, claim, ownership or lane-collision rule changed. Your owned paths and prohibited paths are unchanged.
